description: The Coil Mirror feed: the open legs and the recent messages of what Coil's own trading engine bought and sold, with the fill price, in the order it happened. Each buy and sell message can carry a why: the stage that decided it and the macro, fundamental and technical facts behind it, each a fixed plain sentence. A message never carries a size, a dollar amount, a stop or a target. A message is sent only after the fill is written. While the feed is not being sent, this returns a feed_down status instead of messages. The status is signed with Ed25519; the public key is served at the path /api/mirror/pubkey.

after_seq.description: Optional: return only messages after this seq (the next_after of your last read). Omit for the most recent messages.

limit.description: Optional: the most messages to return

name: get_mirror_feed
